name: Dutch farmland
note: Flat, green and wet. Every measurement should say no.

name: Amazon rainforest
note: A trap: the elevation model includes the tree canopy.

name: Himalayan ridge
note: Rough, but snowy and too steep.

name: Utah badlands
note: Mars-like sediments, terrain only partly similar.

name: Meteor Crater
note: A simple 1.2 km impact crater. Apollo crews trained nearby.

name: Timanfaya
note: Volcanic fields and lava tubes. ESA trains astronauts here.

name: Haughton crater
note: Polar desert impact crater, a long-running NASA Mars analog.

name: McMurdo Dry Valleys
note: Cold, dry and windswept. The classic Mars analog.
